title: Seaside Thyme | KEY.co
description_expanded: Positioned in the heart of Seagrove Beach, this newly built coastal retreat offers an exceptional blend of modern design and effortless beachside living just steps from the Gulf and a short stroll to the charm of Seaside. Expansive open-concept interiors are filled with natural light and elevated finishes, creating a welcoming space for gathering and relaxation. The gourmet kitchen serves as the centerpiece of the home, complete with premium appliances, a gas range, and a butler’s pantry, making entertaining seamless whether hosting family dinners or private chef experiences. Outdoor living is equally inviting, with a private heated pool surrounded by comfortable lounge spaces designed for relaxing after a day at the beach. Multiple balconies offer beautiful Gulf views and peaceful spots for morning coffee or evening conversation, while the outdoor dining area and gas grill make al fresco meals easy and enjoyable. A ping pong table adds a playful touch for family fun, and thoughtful amenities including an elevator, golf cart, and adult bicycles make exploring the surrounding 30A community both simple and memorable.
